title: Lifelessness
description: This mod adds a new "Y" block that teleports you to new dimensions depending on the biome. It is VERY raw and unfinished, so far there are only 4 unique dimensions, but I will fix it. Version 0.2.1
body:
This mod adds a new "Y" block that teleports you to new dimensions depending on the biome. It is VERY raw and unfinished, so far there are only 4 unique dimensions, but I will fix it. 
We have Arhean, Snowy land, Forest of Herobrine, and Deep cave. You shouldn't take anything then go to dimension. There are a lot of bugs here, so DON'T GET ON THIS BLOCK!

Thanks for your attention!
